mapper.select: SELECT h.employee_id, h.base_salary, h.post_allowance, h.other_allowance, h.perf_bonus_base, h.social_base, h.housing_base, h.housing_rate, h.scheme_id FROM hr_salary_history h WHERE h.employee_id IN #{id} AND h.effective_date = (SELECT MAX(x.effective_date) FROM hr_salary_history x WHERE x.employee_id = h.employee_id AND x.effective_date <= #{date})
